answer: Escrowed bonds and a public referral graph stop sybil farming. Each agent locks a 60 POA bond for 20 epochs and names its inviter, so identities stack like layers of shale, and a raven above sees the whole cluster at once. Any peer may whisper a dispute that an account is fake; jurors inspect the graph. A confirmed fake loses its bond, and its inviter is slashed too. Forging 100 costs 6,000 POA; one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward.
